text: The form. Four quatrains, sixteen lines. In each stanza only the second and fourth lines rhyme: a b c b. Begun, sun. Stile, while. Gray, away. Only the first stanza's time and ran is a slant rhyme, a near miss, which suits that breathless, excited opening.
